definition: complete agreeent; perfect harmony, concord.
example_en: There was complete harmony between the two families.

definition: a unit of time (4 seconds or 0.4 second).
example: ಗಳಿಗೆಯ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ ವಿಪಳ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: A part of a ghati is called a vipala.

definition: intense light.
example: ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೊದಱುವೆಳಗು ಹರಡಿ ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Intense light spread across the sky and lit up the whole town.

definition: she who has been sacked from her position, office; etc.
example_en: That woman who was sacked from her position is looking for another job.

definition: the part of the human body extending from the shoulder to the wrist; the arm.
example_en: His arm was strong enough to lift the weight.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: He set out for battle holding a spear.

definition: mocking words; a scoff; a taunt.
example_en: She was hurt by his taunting words.

definition: a plant.
example_en: The kāṇḍatikte plant is used for medicine.

definition: to separate; to divide into different parts, groups or sections.
example_en: He divided the group into two parts.

definition: a man whose work is surveying land; a surveyor.
example_en: The surveyor measured the boundary of the field.

definition: a shed for cattle.
example_en: They had tied the cows in the cattle shed.

definition: very bright, lusterous or brilliant.
example: ಆ ಮಹಾತೇಜ ಯೋಧನ ಕವಚ ಸೂರ್ಯನಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The very bright warrior's armour shone like the sun.

definition: (jain.) the three spheres of air that envelops the earth.
example: ಮೂಗಾಳಿಯು ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say the three spheres of air envelop the earth.

definition: a valve to let something in; an outlet.
example: ಟ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಒಳಬರಲು ಅಂತರ್ಗಮ ಕವಾಟ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: An inlet valve has been fitted for water to enter the tank.

definition: that can be known, realised.
example_en: That truth was knowable to everyone.

definition: the quality or fact of being glittering, sparkling.
example_en: The sparkle of the gem captivated the onlookers.

definition: a sum of money demanded by a government for its support or for specific facilities or services, levied upon incomes, property, sales, entry of goods into a specified area, etc.; a tax.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಹೊಸ ಸರಕುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ತೆಱುಗೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The government imposed a tax on the new goods.

definition: the act of going, departing or moving away.
example_en: The village was saddened by that saint's departure.

definition: the grass Hemarthria compressa of Poaceae family.
example_en: The grass Hemarthria compressa grows in the green meadow.

definition: the grass zeal mayis of Poaceae family.
example_en: The farmers grew maize in the field.

definition: extreme or passionate displeasure; anger.
example: ಮಗನ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ತಂದೆಗೆ ಖಂಗು ಬಂತು.
example_en: Hearing the son's words, the father felt intense anger.

definition: amounting to four in number.
example_en: He has four children.

definition: not young; having lived or been in existence for a long time; aged.
example_en: The aged old man found it difficult to walk.

definition: one who plays a game; a player.
example_en: That player is skilled in the game of chess.

definition: to fuddle or confuse utterly (another); to befuddle.
example_en: The noise befuddled him completely.

definition: the tree Aleurites moluccana of Euphorbraceae family; candlenut tree.
example_en: They broke open the nut of the akhota tree and ate it.

definition: a kind of.
example_en: The child played with the ḍōlaphala.

definition: the mouth of a person who speaks foul language.
example_en: No one spoke because of his foul mouth.

definition: to malignantly administer a poison.
example_en: That wicked man malignantly poisoned his enemy.

definition: the quality of being shrewd, quick, brisk; acumen; smartness.
example: ಅವಳ ಚಾಲಾಕಿಯಿಂದ ಕಷ್ಟದ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಬೇಗ ಬಗೆಹರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Because of her shrewdness the difficult problem was resolved quickly.

definition: giving, imparting knowledge.
example_en: The teacher was one who imparted knowledge to his student.

definition: a strong wish; a desire.
example_en: She had a great desire to study.

definition: he that has eight arms.
example_en: They have installed the idol of the eight-armed one in the temple.

definition: entirely; completely.
example_en: He completed the work entirely.

definition: a bringing up with care; protective fostering.
example_en: She fostered the child with care and love.

definition: a thick, heavy fabric of wool, cotton or synthetic fibres for covering a floor, stairs, etc.; a carpet.
example_en: A thick carpet had been spread on the floor.

definition: (used as an interrogative) what one of the number of things or events mentioned or implied? which?
example_en: Which of these two do you want?

definition: a native or inhabitant of Portugal; a Portuguese.
example_en: That Portuguese man had settled in Goa.

definition: a seat for sages to sit on.
example: ಆ ಮುನಿ ಬೃಸಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಧ್ಯಾನಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The sage sat on the seat and meditated.

definition: to search out and examine systematically the particulars of in an attempt to know the facts about something hidden or complex, esp. in an attempt to find a motive, cause or culprit.
example_en: The police began to investigate the case.

definition: the smooth, glossy, and brightly coloured shell of any gastropod mollusc of the family Cypraeidae, formerly used as currency by primitives; cowrie.
example_en: In the past people used cowrie shells as money.

definition: (dial.) a cylindrical metallic vessel.
example_en: They filled and kept the oil in the metallic vessel.

definition: caused to flare up; lighted; inflamed.
example_en: The fire of revolution was inflamed in the minds of the people.

definition: a mat for people to wipe their feet or shoes on before entering a house, room, etc.; a doormat.
example: ಒಳಗೆ ಬರುವ ಮೊದಲು ಕಾಲೊರಸಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲೊರೆಸಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: Before coming inside, she wiped her feet on the doormat.

definition: the utterance in the presence of another person of a false statement or statements, damaging to a third person's character or reputation; slandering.
example: ಅವನು ಚಹಡೆ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ದೂರ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He drove everyone away with his slanderous talk.

definition: present by virtue of nature; innate; not acquired; natural.
example_en: Love is a natural quality of humans.

definition: a religion that propounds a evil doctrine, esp. one that is fatal to the society.
example_en: That evil doctrine was harmful to society.

definition: the plant Pavonia odorata of Malvaceae family; fragrant sticky mallow.
example_en: Fragrant sticky mallow is used in medicine.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example: ಇದು ಹಳೆಯ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಬಹಳ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This is an old book, it has been here for many years.

definition: in humans, any of the arched bones attached posteriorly to the vertebral column and enclosing the chest cavity; a rib.
example_en: His rib broke in the accident.

definition: a military officer ranking above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier general; a colonel.
example_en: That colonel led the army forward.

definition: to be possible or workable (for a person).
example_en: This plan is possible for her.

definition: a man who is skilled in gambling.
example_en: Being a man skilled in gambling, he did not lose in any game.

definition: the chief clerk who supervises the work of other clerks; a head-clerk.
example_en: The head-clerk of that office is a strict man.

definition: any of the water birds.
example_en: The water birds were swimming in the lake.

definition: the state or condition of being speechless; inability to speak; speechlessness; silence.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅವಾಕ್ಕು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, he was struck speechless.

definition: the chest - a) that part of the mammalian body between the neck and the abdomen in whose cavity the heart and lungs lie; b) the middle of the three chief divisions of the body of an insect or the corresponding part of a crustacean or an arachnid; c) the fore or ventral part of the body between the neck and the abdomen in humans.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎೞ್ದೆ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The word 'eḷde' meaning chest is used in the old poem.

definition: an act of urging; impelling action, influence or force; an impulse; an urge.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಚಾಲನೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Without the teacher's urging, he could not finish the work.

definition: a star glowing brightly.
example_en: A brightly glowing star was twinkling in the night sky.

definition: freedom from (worldly) passions; a non-craving for worldy pleasures; passionlessness.
example_en: The saint attained a state of complete passionlessness.

definition: the quality of being sparse, not dense; sparseness.
example_en: The sparseness of houses in that village is quite noticeable.

definition: the act of trifling, dallying (of a girl or woman) to get men's attention or admiration.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ನಖರಾ ನೋಡಿ ಜನ ನಕ್ಕರು.
example_en: People laughed seeing that girl's coquettish airs.

definition: the tree Sapindus emarginatus of Sapindaceae tree; soapnut tree.
example_en: The villagers used the fruit of the soapnut tree like soap.

definition: the actr or an instance of packing up equipment and leaving the camping ground; the winding up of the camp; decampment.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರು ನಿಪ್ಪಾಳೆಯ ಮಾಡಿ ಬೇರೆ ಕಡೆ ಹೊರಟರು.
example_en: The soldiers struck camp and set off elsewhere.

definition: a person mediating between a seller and a buyer for a fee or a percentage of the sale proceeds or he who negotiates as an intermediary a contract between two or more parties for a commission; a commission agent; a broker.
example_en: That broker conducted the deal honestly.

definition: a government department dealing with foreign affairs; the ministry of foreign affairs.
example_en: The ministry of foreign affairs signed a new agreement.

definition: a stroke with deflected impact; a glancing stroke.
example_en: The glancing stroke of the sword hit the shield and slid off.

definition: the early stage of youth.
example_en: She has just now entered the early stage of youth.

definition: that which is stolen.
example_en: They were selling stolen goods in the market.

definition: to slip or slide (as from one's grip or hold).
example_en: The rope slipped from the hand and fell.

definition: a bottle with a nipple attached to its mouth, used to feed milk to children; a feeding bottle.
example_en: The mother fed the baby milk from the feeding bottle.

definition: a religious sacrifice.
example_en: The priests performed the religious sacrifice in the yajna hall.

definition: to fall or slip back into a former state, practice, etc.; to relapse.
example_en: She relapsed into her old nature.

definition: a kindling of fire for preparing a some oxides, for medicinal purpose.
example_en: They prepared the bhasmapuṭa fire-kindling to make the medicine.

definition: the region of god; the heaven.
example_en: Virtuous souls reach the heaven after death.

definition: (pl.) the propriety and want of it; seemliness and unseemliness.
example_en: A discussion took place in the meeting about propriety and impropriety.

definition: to take clear water into the mouth, agitate as to flush the mouth or teeth.
example_en: Rinsing the mouth after waking up in the morning is a good habit.

definition: ownership of an extent of land got as a gift.
example: ಅಜ್ಜನಿಗೆ ದೊರೆತ ಮನ್ನೆಯಸಾಮ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅವನು ಜೋಪಾನವಾಗಿ ಕಾಪಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He carefully preserved the ownership of the gifted land that his grandfather had received.

definition: a kind of dish, in the shape of small balls, made of wheat flour.
example_en: Mother prepared pavuda sweets for the festival.

definition: gone to the bottom (as of a water-body); ran aground; completely drowned.
example_en: The boat ran aground and sank in the river.

definition: a species of moths whose caterpillars are covered with long tufts of hair; a tussock moth.
example_en: A tussock moth was fluttering near the lamp at night.

definition: any of various classes (esp. Bryopsida) of very small, green bryophytes having stems with leaf-like structures and growing in velvety clusters on rocks; moss.
example_en: Moss grows in damp places.

definition: the movable lid of skin that serves to cover and uncover the front of the eyeball; the eyelid.
example: ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಧೂಳು ಬಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅವನು ರಪ್ಪೆಯನ್ನು ಉಜ್ಜಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: When dust fell into his eye, he rubbed his eyelid.

definition: a bifurcated or forked stick or wood.
example_en: He came holding a forked stick in his hand.

definition: a bad company; a company of rogues, rascals and scoundrels.
example_en: His life was ruined by bad company.

definition: to flow freely, continuously (as rain).
example_en: The rain flowed continuously all night.

definition: an order; a command; a behest.
example_en: The king gave an order to the soldiers.

definition: a dent made by pressing the surface or with a heavy stroke.
example: ಕಾರಿನ ಬಾಗಿಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ನೆಗ್ಗು ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a big dent on the car door.

definition: the act of charging (another) with wrongdoing; accusation; indictment.
example_en: They levelled an accusation of theft against him.

definition: a grade order or class of a body of people, animals or things ranked one above the other, with respect to authority or dominance, esp. in logical and scientific classifications.
example_en: In the company, there are positions according to a hierarchical order.

definition: an abstaining from taking food; the act or an instance of fasting.
example_en: The sages observed fasting for a long time.

definition: a chronic filarial disease resulting in lymphatic obstruction, characterised by marked enlargement of the legs, transmitted by mosquitoes; elephantiasis.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಅನೇಕರಿಗೆ ಪುತ್ತುಂಗಾಲ್ ರೋಗ ಬಂದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Many people in that village suffered from elephantiasis.

definition: to beautify, to adorn; to embellish.
example_en: The flowers beautified the house.

definition: the fact of achieving what one had aimed at or what one's purpose was.
example_en: Through hard work he achieved what he had aimed at.

definition: the organ that pumps blood to and receives it from all parts of the body; the heart.
example_en: His heart beat fast with anxiety.

definition: serious or grievous; severe.
example_en: A severe accusation was brought against him.

definition: a small open craft driven on water by rowing; a boat.
example_en: They crossed the lake sitting in a boat.

definition: fixedness; firmness; immovableness.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡೆಯ ಧ್ರೌವ್ಯ ನೂರಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The firmness of that rock has remained the same for hundreds of years.

definition: to cause to become cool or cooler.
example_en: The fan made the room become cool.

definition: a man who, wearing odd dresses, acts funny in a drama with an intention of rousing laughter.
example: ಆ ಹಗರಣಿಗ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ವೇಷ ಧರಿಸಿ ನಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That comic actor wore an odd costume and made people laugh.

definition: a school where traditional scriptures are taught.
example_en: The children learn the Vedas in the traditional school.

definition: to spread all through; to pervade; to diffuse.
example_en: The fragrance spread all through the room.

definition: a particular kind of mole on the skin (it is believed that snakes will never bite a person having such a mole).
example_en: He had a snake-protecting garuda mole on his arm.

definition: to stand erect or set up oneself in an upright position (as hairs of the head or body).
example_en: Out of fear, the hair on his body stood erect.

definition: any collection of articles, usu. things used in some activity; goods.
example_en: Various kinds of goods were stacked up in the shop.

definition: to cause to move frequently to and from; to cause to vibrate; to shake (an object).
example_en: The wind shook the branches of the tree.

definition: affectionate regard.
example_en: The grandmother showed affectionate regard toward her grandchild.

definition: that cannot produce offspring; sterile; barren.
example: ಆ ಹಸು ಗೊಡ್ಡು ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಕರು ಈಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Since that cow is barren, it did not calve.

definition: (a cow, camel, etc.) to bring back from the first two chamber of the stomach the food swollowed or half-chewed food and chew it slowly and thoroughly again.
example: ಹಸು ಮರದ ನೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ಮೆಲುಕು ಹಾಕುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The cow sat in the tree's shade and chewed the cud.

definition: a remittance of the land revenue collected, to the government treasury .
example_en: The village's remittance of land revenue reached the government treasury.

definition: any of a breed of hound similar to but smaller than the English foxhound, used in packs for hunting hares and rabbits; a harrier.
example: ಬೇಟೆಗಾರರು ಮೊಲಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇಟೆಯಾಡಲು ಅಕ್ಕಬಿಜ್ಜುಗಳ ಗುಂಪನ್ನು ಕರೆದೊಯ್ದರು.
example_en: The hunters took a pack of harriers to hunt rabbits.

definition: of language or linguistics.
example_en: This book has a discussion of linguistic problems.

definition: an ironic, wry smile.
example_en: She answered while giving an ironic, wry smile.

definition: the courteous return of greeting, salutation etc. when greeted, saluted by another.
example_en: She responded to his greeting with a courteous return salutation.

definition: a chaste woman.
example_en: She lived with dignity like a chaste woman.

definition: a sly, stray dog.
example_en: That sly stray dog was wandering along the street.

definition: a wild rose plant; a prickly shrub.
example_en: A wild rose was blooming by the side of the path.

definition: a very caustic speech; pungent word or words; very abusive or contemptuous language or term used to blame anoher.
example_en: Hearing his caustic words, she wept.

definition: (fig.) to provoke another to enter into a quarrel.
example_en: He provoked a quarrel by needlessly stirring trouble.

definition: that which is rough, coarse, uneven.
example_en: The thread of this cloth was coarse and rough.

definition: a kind of perfume.
example: ಆಕೆ ತನ್ನ ಕೂದಲಿಗೆ ನಖಿ ಎಂಬ ಪರಿಮಳ ಹಚ್ಚಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She applied the perfume called nakhi to her hair.

definition: the act of immersing something or going oneself under the surface of a liquid.
example: ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಆೞ್ತೆ ಬಹಳ ಹೊತ್ತು ಮುಂದುವರೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His immersion in the river continued for a long time.

definition: especially; particularly; specifically.
example: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಂದರು, ತತ್ರಾಪಿ ಅವನು ಮೊದಲು ಬಂದನು.
example_en: Everyone came, and he especially came first.

definition: to be contemplating, leading a strict self-denial.
example_en: That sage sat in the forest, contemplating in strict self-denial.

definition: any sound produced from the throat.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಗಳರುತಿ ಕೇಳಿ ತಾಯಿ ಒಳಗೆ ಓಡಿಬಂದಳು.
example_en: Hearing the sound from the baby's throat, the mother came running inside.

definition: a man who spends time idly; an idler.
example: ಆ ದಿಮ್ಮರಂಗ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ದಿನವಿಡೀ ಸುಮ್ಮನಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That idler sat at home and did nothing all day long.

definition: to dress the side-lock,(panne2).
example_en: She dressed the child's side-lock.

definition: not able to walk, move normally; limping.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಕುಂಟಲ ಕಾಲು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಗುಣವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: After the accident, his limping leg did not heal properly.

definition: a building or system where lodging, usu. with boarding, facilities for students is provided; a student-hostel.
example_en: The students are living in the hostel and studying.

definition: the quality or condition of being straight; absence of crookedness.
example_en: The straightness of that road made the journey easy.

definition: to make larger; to increase in size, volume, extent, etc.; to broaden; to expand; to enlarge.
example_en: The company expanded its business.

definition: the food served for eating or eaten.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಜೇಮಣವನ್ನು ಬಡಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಉಣ್ಣಲು ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother served the food and told everyone to eat.

definition: to move around on a circular path.
example_en: The potter shaped the pot by moving the wheel round and round.

definition: a joining together of two or more things, persons in a right and comfortable manner.
example_en: The bond between the two friends was strong.

definition: an agricultural implement used for cutting, lifting, turning over, and partly pulverising soil; a plough.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ರೈತ ಹಾಲ ಹಿಡಿದು ಗದ್ದೆ ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: The village farmer held the plough and tilled the paddy field.

definition: extra information, fact or statistics, that is more than required or considered.
example_en: Extra information has been added to the report.

definition: a soldier trained in the use of cannons, mounted heavy-guns, etc.; an artilleryman.
example_en: The artilleryman was standing on the fort wall.

definition: any animal that has a horn or horns, as a cow, buffalo, etc.
example_en: The buffalo is a horned animal.

definition: a sample, pattern, model.
example: ಈ ಸೀರೆಯ ಮಾಸಲೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಆರಿಸಿದೆವು.
example_en: We chose the cloth by looking at this saree's sample.

definition: penalty of death by hanging a criminal by a rope about the neck; capital punishment.
example: ಆ ಅಪರಾಧಿಗೆ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗಲ್ಲದ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The court sentenced that criminal to the penalty of hanging.

definition: the personal secretary of a king.
example_en: The secretary used to record the king's orders.

definition: a contrary or opposite meaning.
example_en: That word has a completely opposite meaning.

definition: a sentiment, attitude or opinion; a feeling.
example_en: Her attitude kept changing.

definition: the act of guarding, protecting, preserving, keeping, etc.; preservation; protection.
example_en: Protecting the cows is the cowherd's duty.

definition: (said of drinking) with a gulping sound.
example_en: The child drank the beverage with a gulping sound.

definition: a kind of plant (uliga) .
example_en: They planted the uliga plant at the edge of the field.

definition: the act, process or fact of changing or being changed; change; alteration.
example_en: There was a sudden change in the government's policy.

definition: to cut and take one's head: to take a person's life in or as in a sacrifice.
example_en: The king took the enemy's head as a sacrifice.

definition: a painful swelling of a vein in the region of the anus, often with bleeding; haemorrhoids; piles.
example_en: It was difficult for him to sit because he had piles.

definition: a man who drinks alcoholic liquor as a matter of habit or to excess; a habitual drunkard.
example_en: That drunkard drinks alcohol every day.

definition: the act or an instance (of a horse) going at a gallop.
example_en: The horse's galloping astonished everyone.

definition: (the birth-pangs) to become severe.
example_en: The birth-pangs became severe during childbirth.

definition: the act or practice of stealing; theft; thievery.
example_en: Due to poverty in childhood, thievery became a habit for him.

definition: a flower garden.
example_en: There was a flower garden behind the palace.

definition: faultless; unblemished; not guilty; sinless; innocent.
example_en: His behaviour was faultless.

definition: to hide or cover oneself as to get protected (from danger, injury etc.).
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅವನು ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಗುಬರಿದನು.
example_en: When it rained, he took cover under the tree.

definition: the dust sitting on the foot or feet.
example_en: Walking in the sun, the dust on the feet stuck to the clothes.

definition: a tax paid in advance.
example_en: The farmers paid the advance tax to the government.

definition: he who is free from defects; the Supreme.
example_en: Everyone worships the flawless Supreme Being.

definition: the condition of temperature being much lower; the sensation produced by a loss or absence of normal heat; coldness; chillness.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಚಳಿಗಾಲದ ಥಂಡಿ ಬಹಳ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This year's winter coldness is very intense.

definition: the spirit of a person conceived as wandering among or haunting living persons occupying another dead person's body; a kind of ghost.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರು ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚೋಲ ಇದೆಯೆಂದು ಭಯಪಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The villagers feared that a haunting spirit was in that house.

definition: the moon light.
example_en: At night, the moonlight lit up the entire lake.

definition: a non-contiguous skin disorder of unknown cause, characterised by inflammation, itching, and the formation of scales; eczema.
example: ಅವನ ಕೈಗೆ ತದ್ದು ಆಗಿ ತುರಿಕೆ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Eczema appeared on his hand and the itching began.

definition: the place at which a river joins the sea; river mouth; firth; estuary.
example: ನದಿಯ ಅಳಿವೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಮೀನುಗಾರರ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a fishermen's village near the river's estuary.

definition: beer, ale or the like made by fermenting of corns that are first softened and made to sprout by soaking in water and then dried.
example_en: They prepare grain-based beer in that village.

definition: contemptuously rude or impertinent behavior or speech; insolence.
example_en: His insolence annoyed everyone.

definition: a device for reproducing, using a stylus, sound that has been mechanically transcribed in a spiral groove on a circular disk; a gramophone; a phonograph.
example_en: The grandmother was listening to a song on the old gramophone.

definition: that cannot be climbed on; insurmountable.
example: ಆ ದುರಾರೋಹ ಬೆಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ಏರಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one can climb that insurmountable mountain.

definition: having (housing) antelopes.
example_en: That forest was famous for housing antelopes.

definition: any animal in the early period of its life; a young (of an animal).
example_en: That tiger's cub was still small.

definition: excessive thirst, as from physical exertion, heat, etc.
example_en: After walking in the sun, he suffered from excessive thirst.

definition: the belief that there is no God; denial of goḍs existence; atheism.
example: ಆ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕ ನಾಸ್ತಿಕತೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಬರೆದ.
example_en: That philosopher wrote a treatise on atheism.

definition: in advance; in front; ahead; before.
example_en: He came ahead of everyone else.

definition: a man having the qualities generally attributed to women, as weakness, timidity, lack of courage etc.; an effeminate man.
example_en: The effeminate man did no work with courage.

definition: the day in a week on which weekly market is held.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಡವಾರ ದಿನ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A weekly market is held in the village every market day.

definition: much money or property; great amount of worldly possessions; riches; wealth.
example_en: His great wealth was known to the whole town.

definition: a kind of anklet.
example_en: She wore an anklet on her leg.

definition: to go aside; to give way to another.
example: ದೊಡ್ಡವರು ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಅರುಗಿ ದಾರಿ ಬಿಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: As the elders approached, the children stepped aside and gave way.

definition: waste matter from the bowels; excrements; faeces.
example_en: Faeces had collected in the drain and a foul smell was coming.

definition: to lie horizontlly or nearly horzontally on a surface, as bed, couch, ground, etc.
example_en: He lay down on the bed out of tiredness.

definition: the evergreen tree Casuarina equisetifolia of Casuarinaceae family with jointed branchlets that bear whorls of scalelike leaves; beefwood; casuarina.
example_en: A row of casuarina trees stands along the seashore.

definition: a playing, jumping in joy; merrymaking.
example_en: The children played merrily in the garden.

definition: a building or residence for Buddhist monks.
example_en: They built the Buddhist monastery anew.

definition: a jarlike container to spit into; a spittoon; a cuspidor.
example_en: Place a spittoon in the corner.

definition: the manner, way in which the God acts.
example_en: The movement of the world proceeds according to the way God acts.

definition: a collecting of taxes (by the government).
example_en: The government's tax collection increased this year.

definition: (said of cloth, paper) new; not used.
example_en: She brought new, unused cloth from the shop.

definition: involving a mistake, transgression, wrong-doing, sin, etc.
example_en: His wrongful behaviour hurt everyone.

definition: to begin to grow; shoot forth, as a plant from a seed; to sprout.
example_en: In the rainy season, the plant sprouted from the seed.

definition: a kind of cloth.
example_en: We brought pullipatte cloth from the shop.

definition: not indulging or inclined to indulge oneself or giving way to one's own desires.
example: ಆ ಸಂತ ಸದಾ ಅಪ್ರಮತ್ತ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That saint always led a self-disciplined life free from indulgence.

definition: a man who examines or investigates carefully and thoroughly; an examiner; an investigator.
example_en: The investigator examined the case carefully.

definition: an onomatopoeic word formed by imitating the flapping or slapping sound.
example: ಚಪಕ್ ಎಂಬ ಶಬ್ದದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅವನ ಕೈ ಬಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: His hand struck with a slapping sound.

definition: an oblong piece of unstitched cloth worn round the waist by men, to cover upto ankles.
example_en: The village men had wrapped a dhatti cloth around their waists.

definition: all that belongs to one, as one's all properties.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸರ್ವಸ್ವವನ್ನು ದೇಗುಲಕ್ಕೆ ದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He donated all his properties to the temple.

definition: a promise, a commitment to do or refrain from doing, etc., given in writing.
example_en: Both signed a written commitment.

definition: to lose one's beauty, charm; to become ugly.
example_en: After the illness, her face lost its beauty.

definition: to cause to become dull, lusterless or to lose brightenss.
example_en: The dust made the gold ornament lose its brightness.

definition: something that is presented; a presentation; a gift.
example_en: They gave the gift to the bride at the wedding.

definition: the act of marrying; wedding; marriage.
example_en: Their wedding is going to take place next month.

definition: to bring down; to cause to come down.
example_en: They lowered the pot into the well with a rope.

definition: brightness; splendour; effulgence.
example: ಅವಳ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ವಿಶೇಷ ಭಾಸ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a special radiance on her face.

definition: to mark, break or cut the surface of slightly with or as with nails; to scratch.
example_en: The cat scratched the tree with its claws.

definition: an orchard, garden, etc. in the outskirts of a town.
example_en: There is a beautiful garden on the outskirts of the town.

definition: a group of people; a multitude.
example_en: A multitude of people had gathered at the fair all day.

definition: the red beak (of a bird).
example_en: That bird's red beak stood out even from a distance.

definition: the upper limit.
example_en: The government has fixed an upper limit for this scheme.

definition: unequalled; without a second; matchless; unique.
example_en: His talent in this painting is matchless.

definition: a man earning money.
example_en: He is a man who earns money by working hard.

definition: anything uttered that is meaningful and intentional; speech.
example_en: Everyone understood the meaningful words he spoke.

definition: clothes, clothing or apparel worn to cover the body; a dress.
example: ಅವಳು ಹೊಸ ಉಡುಕೆ ಧರಿಸಿ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: She wore new clothing and went to the wedding.

definition: the condition or quality of being contrary; contrariety.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ವಿಪರೀತ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A clear contrariety was evident in his words.

definition: the food fed with love (esp. fed in a single gulp as by birds to their younger ones).
example: ತಾಯಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಮರಿಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಱುಗುಟುಕನ್ನು ತುತ್ತು ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The mother bird fed the loving morsel to its chick.

definition: want of knowledge; ignorance.
example_en: Most of man's troubles arise from ignorance.

definition: speed, force, swiftness or impetuosity of geater degree or intensity.
example_en: The trees bent due to the extreme swiftness of the wind.

definition: a visionary unattainable scheme; a daydream; a castle in the air.
example_en: The lazy man's castle in the air finally collapsed.

definition: the tenth of the twenty seven portions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic.
example: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಜಾತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡಯೋಗ ಬಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The astrologer said that ganda yoga had come in the horoscope.

definition: a kind of incense.
example_en: During worship, they burn that kind of incense.

definition: (dial.) an unripe jack fruit (the fruit of Atrocarpus integra).
example_en: Grandmother brought an unripe jack fruit from the market.

definition: to imagine differently.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಘಟನೆಯನ್ನು ಬೇರೊಂದು ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He imagined that incident in a different way.

definition: a narrow way between hedges, walls, buildings, etc.; narrow country road or city street; a lane.
example_en: There is an old temple at the end of that lane.

definition: a character, trait that is inborn, not acquired.
example_en: Honesty was his inborn trait.

definition: a non-rigid container made of fabric, paper, leather, etc., with an opening at the top that can be closed, with or without a handle; a sack, pouch or bag.
example_en: He filled the rice into a sack.

definition: a hymn, verse, in praise of Viṣṇu.
example_en: The priests recited the Viṣṇu smřti with devotion.

definition: (in hunting) to lure a wild animal with a decoy.
example_en: The hunters used a decoy to lure the deer.

definition: to be lured or enticed by the song of a hunter (said of animals being hunted).
example_en: The deer was lured by the hunter's song.

definition: to keep account of money received and paid out; to account.
example_en: The clerk keeps account every day.

definition: the act, fact, process or an instance of joining together.
example: ಎರಡು ತಂಡಗಳ ಕೂಡುಗೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The new plan was prepared through the joining together of the two teams.

definition: conflict; strife; contention; an extremely difficult situation.
example_en: The struggle of poverty exhausted that family.

definition: the soul of a dead person, a disembodied spirit imagined, wandering among or haunting living persons; a ghost.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೂತು ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say that a ghost lives in the old house.

definition: how much.
example_en: How much does this item cost?

definition: a man wandering in forests.
example: ಆ ವನಚರ ಕಾಡಿನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೂಲೆಯನ್ನೂ ಬಲ್ಲನು.
example_en: That forest wanderer knows every corner of the woods.

definition: a dining plate.
example_en: Mother served the rice on the dining plate.

definition: the state of being separte or apart.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಈಗ ಅಂಗಲ ಉಂಟಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: There is now a state of separation between those two.

definition: to cheat, defraud.
example: ಅವನು ಮುಗ್ಧ ಜನರನ್ನು ಛಳಿಸಿ ಹಣ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: He defrauded innocent people and took money.

definition: a clan of Tamil-speaking people.
example_en: The Mudliyar clan family of the village was advanced in agriculture.

definition: any of various families of winged hymenopteran insects, characterised by a slender body with the abdomen attached by a narrow stalk, biting mouthparts, and, in the females and workers, a vicious sting that can be used repeatedly; a wasp.
example: ಕಡಂದುರು ಹೂವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಮಕರಂದ ಹೀರುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: The wasp is sitting on the flower and sucking nectar.

definition: any of elongated, many-segmented, insect-eating arthropods of Chilopoda class, with a pair of legs to each segment; a centipede.
example_en: A centipede was crawling slowly on the wall.

definition: a worried, anxious, mentally disturbed man.
example_en: He was worried and anxious about the exam result.

definition: the plant Melia composita of Meliaceae family; hill neem.
example_en: The hill neem has grown abundantly on the slope of the hill.

definition: a man who protects; a protector.
example_en: The king was a protector to his subjects.

definition: a part of a whole; a portion.
example_en: He got one portion of the property.

definition: a compact, usu. impure, massive variety of talc, used to make electrical insulators and also to carve idols; soapstone; steatite.
example_en: That factory used to bring soapstone from the mine.

definition: excessive indulgence in extra marital sexual relations.
example: ಅವನ ಜಾರತೆ ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಅವಮಾನ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His promiscuous conduct brought shame to the whole family.

definition: turned from what is right; wicked; misguided; distorted; perverted.
example: ಅವನ ವಿಕಾರಿ ನಡವಳಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಘಾತ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His wicked, perverted behavior shocked everyone.

definition: a sharp, lifeless excrescence on a plant; a spine; a prickle; a thorn.
example: ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಮುಳ್ ಚುಚ್ಚಿ ಅವನು ನೋವಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಗಿದನು.
example_en: A thorn pricked his foot and he cried out in pain.

definition: having a tendency to deride, ridicule; showing derision; ridiculing.
example_en: She was hurt by his ridiculing words.

definition: healing or capable of healing; efficacious; effective (as a drug).
example_en: This medicine is very effective for fever.

definition: something produced; yield; esp., agricultural production, fresh fruits and vegetables.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಹೊಲದ ಅಯಿವಜು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This year the field's yield has come well.

definition: a string or a rope for tying a dog.
example_en: He tied a rope around the dog's neck.

definition: a member of the Lacertilia, having four legs, green body, moveable eyelids; lacerta interpunctula.
example: ಹಸಿರು ಅರಣೆಯು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The green lizard was basking in the sunlight on the rock.

definition: the original and characteristic smell (as of some vegetables).
example_en: This vegetable has a distinctive characteristic smell.

definition: a piece of cleared land, set off or enclosed, for raising crops; an agricultural land.
example_en: The farmer grew paddy in the agricultural land.

definition: the act of shaving the head.
example_en: Before the initiation, they had the teacher's head shaved.

definition: the quality or fact of being angular; angularity.
example_en: The angularity is prominent in that building's design.

definition: a person of determination; a strong-willed person.
example: ಕೃತಮತಿಯಾದ ಆ ಯುವಕ ತನ್ನ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That determined young man did not give up his goal.

definition: a furious, uncontrolled anger; fury; infuriation.
example_en: Hearing the news, the king flew into a furious rage.

definition: that exceeds counting; countless; innumerable; immense.
example_en: There are countless stars in the sky.

definition: that which is superior, excellent in quality, merit, etc.
example_en: That student was recognized as superior in the class.

definition: the shape, outline or configuration of anything; structure as apart from colour, material, etc.; the form.
example_en: The shape of that vessel was round all around.

definition: to be taken aback from fear, sudden surprise, etc.
example_en: He was taken aback on seeing the snake.

definition: a tree of Coniferae family; wild Deodar.
example_en: Wild deodar trees have grown on the hill.

definition: vulgar; coarse; debased; undignified; low.
example_en: No one tolerates such vulgar behaviour.

definition: one of the Dravidian languages that is closer to Tamil.
example: ಇಬ್ಬಾರ ಭಾಷೆ ತಮಿಳಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದ ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ಭಾಷೆ.
example_en: The Ibbara language is a Dravidian language close to Tamil.

definition: a barking (of dogs).
example_en: The barking of the dogs was loud at night.

definition: to detatch oneself from the worldly passions, attachments; to become dispassionate.
example_en: The sage detached himself from worldly attachments.

definition: (masc.) an expert in sculpture.
example: ಆ ಸಂಚುಗಾಱ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಕೆತ್ತನೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That sculpture expert carved the stone of the temple.

definition: a place or locality.
example_en: This place is fit for worship.

definition: the inner discipline; the discipline of the mind.
example_en: Inner discipline is very important for a seeker.

definition: to cause to give out (splendour, talent, skill, etc.).
example_en: The teacher caused the disciple's talent to shine forth.

definition: (dial.) a young bovine animal (as of a cow); a calf.
example_en: The cow affectionately licked its calf.

definition: a dream or series of dreams prompted by tender and gentle feelings.
example_en: The grandmother saw her childhood in a gentle dream.

definition: a quantity, number, extent that is three times the given quantity, number, extent etc.
example: ಅವನ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಈಗ ಮೊದಲಿನ ಮೂಮೆಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: His property has now grown to three times the original amount.

definition: something said or done in answer; a reply; response.
example_en: A proper reply did not come to his question.

definition: to prepare; to make ready.
example_en: Prepare the food quickly.

definition: a taking of care of something or someone, esp. of a house, estate, administration, etc., for a person not present always; a caretaking; supervision.
example_en: He took good care of supervising the house.

definition: a prolonged period of dry weather; lack of rain; drought.
example_en: There was a shortage of fodder for the cattle during the drought.

definition: to follow a method, manner or established custom; to adhere to a discipline.
example_en: A good cook follows a method in his work.

definition: a mark, scar one the body.
example_en: A scar remained on his body from the accident.

definition: to give something in exchange for something else; to exchange goods or services.
example_en: Both the merchants exchanged goods with each other.

definition: the art of dance.
example_en: The teacher taught her the art of dance.

definition: a kind of blanket.
example_en: In winter people sleep covered with that kind of blanket.

definition: the reverberating sound (as of bees, stringed instrument when plucked, etc.).
example_en: The reverberating hum of the bees sounded sweet to the ear.

definition: a man having honorific title or titles.
example_en: The king honoured him by giving him a title.

definition: a refraining from speech or from making noise; silence.
example_en: One should maintain silence inside the temple.

definition: to wait eagerly, anticipate for an opportunity.
example_en: The hunter stood behind the bush, waiting eagerly for an opportunity.

definition: a box kept by the postal department for collection of letters for onward transmission to the addressees; a post box.
example_en: He dropped the letter into the post box.

definition: the total of what one remembers.
example_en: The total of what she remembers still remains clear.

definition: the art of acrobatics.
example_en: That girl learned the art of acrobatics since childhood.

definition: bravery; valour; prowess.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ವೀರನ ಸಘಾಟಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That warrior's bravery in the battle amazed everyone.

definition: gold that shines brightly.
example_en: The brightly shining gold (kanatkāncana) glowed in the ornament.

definition: to understand, know by a sign or signs.
example_en: He understood by the sign alone.

definition: a dividing line between two countries, states, etc; border; boundary; frontier.
example_en: They had drawn a boundary line between the two kingdoms.

definition: (property, valuables, etc.) the fact of being pledged.
example_en: The pledging of the property was recorded in the document.

definition: that which is cut or severed.
example_en: Cut grass lay fallen on the ground.

definition: very green; absolutely green.
example_en: During the rainy season the field looked absolutely green.

definition: rice in the husk, the seed of the aquatic cereal grass Oryza sativa of Poaceae family; paddy.
example_en: The farmers grew paddy in the field.

definition: not suffering from any defect or flaw; perfect.
example: ಅವನ ಕೆಲಸ ಯಾವುದೇ ದೋಷವಿಲ್ಲದ ಅನೂನಕ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone said his work was flawless and perfect.

definition: the overbearing activity, behaviour; disdainful treatment.
example_en: No one tolerated her disdainful behaviour.

definition: the capacity to bear or carry a burden.
example_en: He does not have the capacity to bear such a big responsibility.

definition: a man struck with wonder.
example_en: On hearing the award announcement, he became a man struck with wonder.

definition: Karṇa, an associate of Kauravas in Mahābhārata, the great epic of India.
example_en: Karna fought on the side of the Kauravas.

definition: the quality or fact of being - a) careful about delicate things; b) finely sensitive in feeling, understanding, discriminating; c) finely skilled.
example_en: Her delicacy and skillfulness stand out clearly in her work.

definition: an ass living naturally in a wild state; a wild ass.
example_en: A herd of wild asses roamed in the desert.

definition: the string of a bow.
example_en: The hunter tightened the bowstring.

definition: undecided; left undecided; unsettled.
example_en: That matter still remains undecided.

definition: (the body) to lose all vital biological functions; to die.
example_en: Injured in the accident, he died in the hospital.

definition: the state of being first in time, place or rank.
example_en: Priority should always be given to health.

definition: a loud and hoarse laughter.
example_en: The demon's loud laughter echoed throughout the forest.

definition: (a term of abuse) a son of a harlot.
example_en: They abused him calling him a son of a harlot.

definition: a stopping or being stopped from moving; stoppage.
example: ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಹನಗಳ ನಿಲ್ಪು ಸಂಚಾರಕ್ಕೆ ತೊಂದರೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The stoppage of vehicles on the road caused trouble for traffic.

definition: an enlargement of the thyroid gland, often visible as a swelling in the lower part of the front of the neck; goitre.
example: ಆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಗಂಡಮಾಲೆ ಇರುವುದನ್ನು ವೈದ್ಯರು ಪತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctors detected that the patient had a goitre.

definition: to become mentally unsound; to become insane or mad.
example_en: He became insane from grief.

definition: a liquid that has been stirred as to make the ingredients in it disturbed.
example_en: The rainwater flowed stirred and muddy.

definition: one of the lower limbs, from the knee to the foot; the shank.
example_en: His shank was shivering in the cold.

definition: the feeling or sentiment of love, affection.
example_en: The feeling of love was visibly showing in her eyes.

definition: reputation; fame; renown.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯ ನಿರೂಢಿ ಇಡೀ ನಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: That poet's fame spread throughout the land.

definition: a small bridge.
example_en: There was a small bridge over the stream.

definition: corresponding; matching; homogenous; commensurate.
example_en: His words were commensurate with the situation.

definition: the state or quality of being complex; intricacy; complexity.
example_en: Ordinary people do not understand the complexity of this law.

definition: the sharp, short sound made by snapping a finger with the thumb.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಚುಟಿಕೆ ಹೊಡೆದು ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆದರು.
example_en: The teacher snapped his fingers with a chutike sound and drew the disciple's attention.

definition: the act of making a hole (as by piercing with a pointed instrument).
example_en: The needle's piercing pricked the cloth.

definition: practice of non-violence and abstention from harming other living beings.
example_en: Gandhiji observed the vow of non-violence throughout his life.

definition: the white ant that has wings; termite.
example: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ರೆಕ್ಕೆಯ ಈಸುೞ್ ದೀಪದ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಹಾರಿ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In the rainy season the winged termite flies towards the lamp.

definition: a heap of things.
example_en: A heap of garbage lay in the courtyard.

definition: any warm-blooded vertebrate of the class Aves, having a body covered with feathers, forelimbs modified into wings, scaly legs, a beak, and no teeth, and bearing young in a hard-shelled egg; a bird.
example_en: Birds were flying together in the sky.

definition: a clear, shrill sound made by whistling or blowing a whistle.
example_en: The bird flew away hearing the man's whistle.

definition: the cardinal number twenty-four; 24.
example_en: There were twenty-four students in the class.

definition: a friend; an intimate companion.
example: ಅವನ ಸಚಿವರು ಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: His intimate companion did not abandon him in trouble.

definition: of or relating to the fourth one.
example_en: This chapter relates to the fourth part.

definition: the act or profession of husking paddy by beating.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭತ್ತದ ಕೊಟ್ಟಣ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಸುಬಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In that village, husking paddy by beating was a major profession.

definition: the act or process of mixing (different things) together; blending.
example_en: A new colour was prepared by the blending of colours.

definition: a pleasure outing at which a meal is eaten outdoors; picnic.
example: ನಾವೆಲ್ಲ ಭಾನುವಾರ ನದಿ ದಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಿಕನಿಕ್ಕು ಆಯೋಜಿಸಿದೆವು.
example_en: We all organized a picnic on the riverbank on Sunday.

definition: to speak; to utter.
example_en: The child spoke for the first time.

definition: to give, send or do (something) what has been given or sent.
example_en: The king sent back the letter that had come.

definition: an act of slipping, losing grip of one's feet or sliding on a smooth surface.
example: ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಾರು ಆಗಿ ಅವನು ಬಿದ್ದ.
example_en: He slipped on the stairs and fell.

definition: a trial impression taken for checking errors, making corrections before final printing; a proof.
example_en: The printer sent the proof for inspection.

definition: an animal akin to squirrel.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಉಡುವೆ ಮರದಿಂದ ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಜಿಗಿಯಿತು.
example_en: A squirrel-like animal leapt from tree to tree in the forest.

definition: made in Paiṭhaṇa, a town near Aurangābad, in Mahārashṭra.
example_en: She wore a sari made in Paithan.

definition: a kind of bean plant.
example_en: In that region, they grow that kind of bean plant extensively.

definition: the act of betrothing or fact of being betrothed; betrothal; engagement.
example_en: They will hold the betrothal ceremony next month.
